crossRefs.note: I will keep my loving kindness for him forever more. My covenant will stand firm with him.
I will also make his offspring endure forever, and his throne as the days of heaven.
So Israel rebelled against David’s house to this day.
Your holy people possessed it but a little while. Our adversaries have trodden down your sanctuary.
All day long my dishonor is before me, and shame covers my face,
Let my adversaries be clothed with dishonor. Let them cover themselves with their own shame as with a robe.
Then my enemy will see it, and shame will cover her who said to me, where is Yahweh your God? Then my enemy will see me…

translations.web: You have shortened the days of his youth. You have covered him with shame.
translations.bsb: You have cut short the days of his youth; You have covered him with shame. Selah
translations.kjv: The days of his youth hast thou shortened: thou hast covered him with shame. Selah.
translations.asv: The days of his youth hast thou shortened: Thou hast covered him with shame. Selah
